dialogues.speaker: Artyom
dialogues.text: W-Wait, what? Don't say that! This is my first time at the theater!

dialogues.speaker: Artyom
dialogues.text: That ticket cost a fortune, and I saved up forever to get it. You're telling me that was the whole thing?

dialogues.speaker: Artyom
dialogues.text: No, no, no. I don't buy it. Maybe there's no encore, fine, but what if the actors come back out from backstage with some kind of surprise?

dialogues.speaker: Artyom
dialogues.text: I'm staying right here... just in case.
